name: needs_resolution
description: CLOSE-THE-LOOP tracker for real worker needs. Reads the honest worker-needs queue (qsb_worker_needs_queue.json) and the Task Council board, and for each OPEN need shows: the real need, its source floor, whether a real council task already addresses it, and its resolution state (open / in-progress / resolved). action=digest is read-only. action=resolve marks a need resolved in Wren's OWN append-only registry data/registries/qsb_wren_needs_resolution.jsonl, but ONLY with real cited evidence (a matching council task that is done, or a real booked/dispatched fix task) — it REFUSES to resolve a need without a real task id on the live board. R01 honest: nothing is invented, every resolution cites a real task id + its real state.
authored_by: Claude for Wren (additive close-the-loop skill; touches no mind/persona file)
